description: Indian stock market MCP server for NSE & BSE — 55 tools across all 8,200+ stocks: live quotes, financials, technicals, 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains & IV, filings, IPOs & portfolio. Remote (OAuth) or npx. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Codex & Gemini CLI

tool_signatures.name: Retired
tool_signatures.description: Replacement

tool_signatures.name: add_portfolio_stocks
tool_signatures.description: Add holdings singly or in bulk, including rows parsed from a broker CSV or screenshot (Zerodha, Groww, Angel One, Dhan, Upstox, 5Paisa, ICICI Direct, Kotak, HDFC Sky, Motilal Oswal). Duplicates merge on a weighted-average price.

tool_signatures.name: add_to_watchlist
tool_signatures.description: Follow one or many stocks. Idempotent.

tool_signatures.name: get_adjustment_factors
tool_signatures.description: Split and bonus adjustment timeline for reconstructing raw prices — plus the rights and demerger events that carry no reliable factor at all.

tool_signatures.name: get_batch_quotes
tool_signatures.description: Up to 20 stock quotes in a single call.

tool_signatures.name: get_company_profile
tool_signatures.description: Full overview — sector, business summary, pros/cons, fundamentals, growth metrics, current quote. Optionally add technicals (20+ indicators), analyst ratings, and peers in the same call.

tool_signatures.name: get_corporate_actions
tool_signatures.description: Alias of get_stock_events with type: "corporate_actions".

tool_signatures.name: get_credit_ratings
tool_signatures.description: Credit-rating actions by agency with rating, action, and outlook over time.

tool_signatures.name: get_document_summary
tool_signatures.description: Investor digest of one filing by doc_id (or the newest of a doc_type): summary, highlights, risks, management guidance, key metrics. Capped at 6k chars; truncated: true marks an abridged digest.

tool_signatures.name: get_earnings_call_summary
tool_signatures.description: Structured digest of recent earnings-call transcripts and investor presentations — highlights, risks, guidance, headline metrics.

tool_signatures.name: get_fii_dii_detail
tool_signatures.description: 30 days of daily cash-market flows, F&O participant long/short OI, weekly/monthly/yearly aggregates, buy/sell streaks, cumulative net flows.

tool_signatures.name: get_fii_dii_flows
tool_signatures.description: Alias of get_fii_dii_detail.

tool_signatures.name: get_financials
tool_signatures.description: Quarterly + annual P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and ratios. Each period is stamped with when it was actually published, so backtests can avoid look-ahead bias.

tool_signatures.name: get_forecasts
tool_signatures.description: Analyst EPS, revenue, EBITDA, net income, ROA, and ROE estimates against actuals — for spotting earnings surprises.

tool_signatures.name: get_fpi_sectors
tool_signatures.description: FPI investment by sector — AUM share, fortnightly change, 1-year cumulative flow.

tool_signatures.name: get_identifiers_asof
tool_signatures.description: The reverse lookup — which symbol and ISIN a company traded under at a point in time.

tool_signatures.name: get_index_history
tool_signatures.description: OHLC level series plus PE/PB/dividend yield for a single index. The index counterpart of get_price_history.

tool_signatures.name: get_index_membership_asof
tool_signatures.description: Was a stock in an index on a given date? Answers present, uncertain, absent, or out_of_coverage — survivorship-bias-aware universe construction.

tool_signatures.name: get_index_performance
tool_signatures.description: Rank ~140 NSE indices by return over completed weeks or months. Filter to sectoral, broad, thematic, or strategy families — the right answer to "which sector led last month".

tool_signatures.name: get_india_vix
tool_signatures.description: The India VIX fear gauge — latest level, daily change, recent history.

tool_signatures.name: get_live_quote
tool_signatures.description: Alias of get_stock_quote.

tool_signatures.name: get_market_data
tool_signatures.description: One dispatcher for seven daily feeds via dataset: deals, fno_ban, deliveries, ipo, mtf, slbm, signals.

tool_signatures.name: get_market_news
tool_signatures.description: Market-wide news across categories with sentiment and related symbols.

tool_signatures.name: get_market_pulse
tool_signatures.description: The at-a-glance daily snapshot — FII/DII net flows, Nifty 50 valuations, and India VIX in one call.

tool_signatures.name: get_observation_status
tool_signatures.description: Per-calendar-day reason a price is present or missing: traded, weekend, holiday, pre-listing, delisted, or no print. A missing day is not a zero return.

tool_signatures.name: get_option_chain
tool_signatures.description: Per-strike index option chain with IV, full Greeks, bid/ask, open interest, max pain, PCR. NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY — a stamped end-of-day snapshot.

tool_signatures.name: get_option_iv_history
tool_signatures.description: Session-by-session ATM IV, IV rank, IV percentile, realised vol, PCR, max pain, 25-delta skew for ~556 underlyings, individual stocks included.

tool_signatures.name: get_options_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Latest per-expiry aggregates — ATM IV, IV rank/percentile, realised vol, PCR by OI and volume, max pain, skew, call/put OI.

tool_signatures.name: get_price_history
tool_signatures.description: Daily or weekly OHLCV with delivery %. Up to 2,000 sessions per call, pageable further back.

tool_signatures.name: get_promoter_pledge
tool_signatures.description: Promoter share-pledge percentage by quarter plus pledge/release events — a standard governance red-flag check.

tool_signatures.name: get_quant_signal
tool_signatures.description: get_tapetide_score (a different measurement, not a rename)

tool_signatures.name: get_screener_ratios
tool_signatures.description: Search or browse the full 326-ratio catalog to get exact ratio names for a query.

tool_signatures.name: get_shareholding
tool_signatures.description: Promoter, FII, DII, and public holdings quarter by quarter.

tool_signatures.name: get_stock_deals
tool_signatures.description: Bulk, block, insider, and substantial-acquisition (SAST) disclosures per stock, with counterparty, side, quantity, value.

tool_signatures.name: get_stock_events
tool_signatures.description: Sentiment-tagged news, corporate actions (dividends, splits, bonuses, AGMs), and filings (results, presentations, concall transcripts, annual reports).

tool_signatures.name: get_stock_news
tool_signatures.description: Alias of get_stock_events with type: "news".

tool_signatures.name: get_stock_ownership
tool_signatures.description: Dividend history with yields + which mutual fund schemes hold the stock and at what share of AUM.

tool_signatures.name: get_stock_quote
tool_signatures.description: Live price — LTP, change %, volume, market cap, PE, PB, 52-week high/low.

tool_signatures.name: get_tapetide_score
tool_signatures.description: The deterministic 0-100 Tapetide Score for one stock with its six pillar sub-scores, band, percentile, data confidence, and any governance caps or red flags.

tool_signatures.name: get_trending_stocks
tool_signatures.description: Today's top gainers, losers, and most-active stocks from the Nifty 500.

tool_signatures.name: get_user_portfolio
tool_signatures.description: Holdings with live prices, absolute and % P&L, invested value, weight, sector, market-cap class.

tool_signatures.name: get_watchlist
tool_signatures.description: Every followed stock with sector and industry.

tool_signatures.name: list_company_documents
tool_signatures.description: Index of a company's parsed filings — concall transcripts, annual reports, investor presentations, IPO documents — with doc_id, period, page count, what is available for each, and links to the PDF and full Markdown. Call this first.

tool_signatures.name: market_deals
tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "deals"

tool_signatures.name: market_deliveries
tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "deliveries"

tool_signatures.name: market_fno_ban
tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "fno_ban"

tool_signatures.name: market_heatmap
tool_signatures.description: Every constituent of an index with market cap, PE, PB, returns from 1d to 5y, volume, sector — 16 indices.

tool_signatures.name: market_ipo
tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "ipo"

tool_signatures.name: market_mtf

tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "signals"

tool_signatures.description: get_market_data with dataset: "slbm"

tool_signatures.name: market_valuations
tool_signatures.description: Index PE, PB, and dividend yield over time. Up to 20 years.

tool_signatures.name: read_document
tool_signatures.description: The Markdown text of a filing by doc_id and page range, with <!-- page N --> markers to cite from. At most 12 pages / 24k chars per call; the result names the pages returned and the next_pages to fetch.

tool_signatures.name: read_me
tool_signatures.description: The full in-session guide — every tool by category, the SEBI disclaimer rule, portfolio-first behaviour, parallel-call patterns. Assistants should call it first.

tool_signatures.name: remove_from_watchlist
tool_signatures.description: Unfollow one or many stocks.

tool_signatures.name: remove_portfolio_stocks
tool_signatures.description: Remove holdings from the portfolio.

tool_signatures.name: resolve_identifier_asof
tool_signatures.description: Map a historical symbol or ISIN to the company that held it on a date, for old holdings files and recycled tickers.

tool_signatures.name: run_preset_screen
tool_signatures.description: Redirect that points a preset-screen request at the screener tool that can actually answer it.

tool_signatures.name: scan_movers
tool_signatures.description: Alias of get_trending_stocks.

tool_signatures.name: screen_by_quant_signal
tool_signatures.description: screen_tapetide_scores (a different measurement, not a rename)

tool_signatures.name: screen_stocks
tool_signatures.description: Fundamental screener over 326 ratios — PE, ROCE, sales growth, debt/equity, Piotroski score. Plain-English query syntax with AND/OR logic and cross-field comparisons.

tool_signatures.name: screen_stocks_technical
tool_signatures.description: Real-time technical screener — RSI, MACD, SMA/EMA crossovers, Bollinger Bands, ADX, volume, momentum. Supports crosses_above/crosses_below.

tool_signatures.name: screen_tapetide_scores
tool_signatures.description: Rank and filter the scored universe by band, size bucket, sector, score window, and confidence, with cursor pagination.

tool_signatures.name: search_stocks
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a company to its symbol by name, symbol, BSE code, or ISIN — including brand names and post-rename aliases (Zomato → ETERNAL). Filter by sector/industry.

tool_signatures.name: update_portfolio_stock
tool_signatures.description: Update quantity and average price after a top-up or partial sell.
